content: जनक {%a.%} (निका|{%f.%}) [जन्-णिच् ण्वुल्] Generating, producing, causing; क्लेशजनक, दुःखजनक <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-कः@} .²1 A father, progenitor. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a famous king of Videha or Mithilā, foster-father of Sītā. He was remarkable for his great knowledge, good works, and holiness. After the abandonment of Sītā by Rāma, he became an anchorite--indifferent to pleasure or pain-- and spent his time in philosophical discussions. The sage याज्ञवल्क्य was his priest and adviser.
